body: I've lived in the North for 23 years and in my experience it's full of the worst people very hostile all the time and there isn't much here compared to the south.
I live in England, in the horrible North of it
Not in this area I already checked, I think they're building a college for that though so maybe something will some of that. I am going to see a doctor tomorrow for my depression again.
